notes:
Dahu 0.98.1 beta for Windows

Changes since 0.98.0:
- Long geometry operations no longer fail at the host's fixed two-minute response deadline. The app keeps waiting for the result.
- The loading window shows elapsed geometry-processing time, with an indeterminate progress indicator.
- Committed changes are saved to recovery even if the client disconnects before receiving the reply.
- Large viewport mesh caches remain effective above 5,000 entries, avoiding unnecessary full mesh retransmissions.
- Actual disconnected or incomplete geometry-engine replies show a clearer recovery message.

This patch fixes the false timeout failure; complex 3DM conversion can still take several minutes. Forced cancellation during native geometry conversion and real 4K performance tuning remain separate work. Some Rhino Breps may use saved render-mesh fallbacks when exact reconstruction is unavailable.

Validation: 148 workflow checks, a real response delayed beyond 120 seconds, disconnected/truncated-reply tests, failed-reply autosave checks, and isolated Windows desktop/updater checks including valid and altered signatures.

Includes the Windows installer, updater signature and corresponding AGPL source archive. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.
